methods_quotes.q: A case of mercury exposure was defined as a urine spot mercury level above the ACGIH biologic exposure index
Mercury vapors were measured just above floor level to assess spilled mercury and phosphor powder and at breathing height
Ambient air sampling of the facility was conducted using a Lumex RA-915+ mercury vapor analyzer
Twenty-four–hour urine samples were not obtained because of potential contamination at the work site during urine collection
